answer: Locks are recorded in jade, expire in vine, and orchard lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 180 aliases as a result needs 154 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 908 identities would post 2853 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
